operative.text: 定身残留身份由 WP40 §4.1 的普通选择/非特殊执行前门消费：身份匹配就拒绝，不要求计数正。默认 DISABLE 成功写计数5及最近普通招式身份后，有效精神香草把计数清0并消费，已完成的治疗和消费不因后来的招式拒绝退回。同一成员继续存活在场、无重新初始化/变身/后续定身覆盖等改写时，本轮及后续正常回合末的定身递减因计数0被跳过，不到清身份的自然结束回调。无香草时正计数实际递减到0才清身份；正常换入初始化及实际变身也可清掉该身份，不能推成永久禁用。其它招式只按各自资格判定，特殊使用仅绕该定身门，不保证整个执行成功或必选挣扎。HI10及HI10a–HI10f分开本地结果、下一菜单拒绝和先合法登记后的同轮执行拒绝。

manual_meanings: Mental Herb clears the Disable count only; ordinary choice/execution compares the retained identity without requiring a positive count.
After count0, the positive-count end-round guard skips expiry and cannot reach that expiry branch identity clear.
Without Herb, the positive count decrements and reaching0 clears identity. Normal initialization and completed Transform independently clear count and identity.
Special usage bypasses the stated Disable gate only; other gates still apply. Later move rejection does not restore completed Herb healing or consumption.
receipts.ordinary_control: Live unchanged holder after eligible Herb: count0/identityX, ordinary X rejected.
receipts.minimal_control: Positive count without Herb can expire; actual reinitialization/Transform clears identity; another move retains its own gates.
